description: Config (core contract section 4). envNames: a key and the environment variable that overrides it. values: a setting type and a text, and the parsed value or the error ('expected ...' text). Normalised values: integer and long as JSON numbers, boolean as true/false, duration as a decimal string of nanoseconds, stringList as an array, secret as its revealed text, enum (members FAST and SLOW_START) as the member name. scenarios: config files, environment and declarations (type, optional typed default, required), and the resolved values (null when a setting has no value) or every start-up problem as the Java ConfigProblem text, with the config directory written as config/. Defaults are typed: durations as defaultMillis.

scenarios.name: sources in order: default, application.yaml, application-test.yaml, secrets.local.yaml, environment

files.application.yaml:

  a: from-app
  b: from-app
  c: from-app
  d: from-app
files.application-test.yaml:
svc:
  b: from-env-file
  c: from-env-file
  d: from-env-file

scenarios.name: secrets.local.yaml is ignored outside local and test

files.application.yaml:
svc:
  port: 8080
  on: true
  list: [a, 1, false]
  csv: x, y
  timeout: 30s
  nothing:
  empty: {}

scenarios.name: every problem at once; a secret's text is never quoted

files.application.yaml:
svc:
  port: eighty
  timeout: 5 minutes
  tags: { a: 1 }
  mode: medium

problems: module 'svc': key 'svc.port' (from config/application.yaml): expected an integer, found 'eighty'
module 'svc': key 'svc.timeout' (from config/application.yaml): expected a duration such as 500ms, 30s, 5m, 2h, 1d or PT30S, found '5 minutes'
module 'svc': key 'svc.name': missing required setting; set it in config/application.yaml or as environment variable SVC_NAME
module 'svc': key 'svc.token': missing required setting; set it in config/application.yaml, config/secrets.local.yaml (local and test only) or as environment variable SVC_TOKEN
module 'svc': key 'svc.retries' (from environment variable SVC_RETRIES): expected a long integer, found 'many'
module 'svc': key 'svc.mode' (from config/application.yaml): expected one of FAST, SLOW_START, found 'medium'
